verdict.rationale: Poke is an AI assistant, so real-time voice conversation is a fair axis, but the evidence only describes text-based messaging on Apple Messages, Telegram, WhatsApp and RCS. The 'phone calls' release note refers to real people handling tasks for the user, not voice conversation with the assistant. Nothing documents live voice interaction.

support.subject: As a knowledge-worker, I can have a natural, real-time voice conversation with the assistant
